title: Network Latency Chain (RTT / DNS / TLS / Proxy / App / DB)
description: End-to-end network and application latency chain across Blackbox external probes, Exporter outbound HTTP phase instrumentation, Edge Caddy /split reverse proxy, Host TCP/network saturation, and OTel spanmetrics for Accounts/Billing/PostgreSQL.

panels.title: 1 · Blackbox External Probe Reachability & Phase Duration (DNS / TCP / TLS / TTFB / Transfer)
panels.description: External Blackbox Exporter probe success, ICMP RTT, and HTTP phase breakdown (resolve, connect, tls, processing, transfer).

panels.title: 2 · Exporter Outbound HTTP Phase Latency (DNS / TCP / TLS / TTFB / Total)
panels.description: httptrace-instrumented outbound HTTP phase latency from xray-Exporter. Reused connections omit dns/tcp_connect/tls_handshake observations instead of recording synthetic 0s.

panels.title: 3 · Edge Caddy /split Latency & Upstream Failure Events
panels.description: Edge Caddy HTTP response duration quantiles and xhttp_events_total failure categories (socket_missing, unexpected_eof, upstream_reset, connection_refused, other_502, xray_started).

panels.title: 4 · Host Network Saturation & TCP Retransmits
panels.description: Node Exporter TCP segment retransmission rate and NIC RX/TX packet drop rate.

panels.title: 5 · Application Request & Database Span Latency (OTel spanmetrics)
panels.description: Application HTTP handler and PostgreSQL query/exec span latency (p50/p95/p99) and call rate derived from OTel Collector spanmetrics.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, span_name, transport) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{env=~"$env", service_name=~"web-saas-accounts|web-saas-billing|$service_name", transport=~"$transport|^$"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, span_name, db_operation) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{env=~"$env", span_name=~"sql\\.conn\\.(query|exec)"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 6 · Latency Phase Boundaries & Missing-Data Semantics Guide

options.content:
### Network Latency Chain — Phase Boundaries & Missing-Data Semantics

| Phase Metric / Attribute | Boundary Definition | Missing / Reused Connection Semantics |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `dns_ms` / `phase="dns"` / `phase="resolve"` | Client DNS lookup start (`DNSStart`) to completion (`DNSDone`) | **Omitted (`not_observed`)** when connecting by IP literal or reusing an existing HTTP keep-alive connection. Never padded with synthetic `0`. |
| `tcp_connect_ms` / `phase="tcp_connect"` / `phase="connect"` | TCP SYN (`ConnectStart`) to TCP handshake completion (`ConnectDone`) | **Omitted (`not_observed`)** on pooled/reused connections (`GotConnInfo.Reused=true`) or Unix domain sockets. |
| `tls_handshake_ms` / `phase="tls_handshake"` / `phase="tls"` | TLS ClientHello (`TLSHandshakeStart`) to Finished (`TLSHandshakeDone`) | **Omitted (`not_observed`)** on plaintext HTTP or reused TLS connections. |
| `ttfb_ms` / `phase="ttfb"` / `phase="processing"` | Request fully written (`WroteRequest`) to first response byte (`GotFirstResponseByte`) | Measures upstream proxy + application processing + network RTT after connection setup. |
| `request_total_ms` / `phase="total"` | Total client round-trip from request start to response body close | Always recorded on completed requests. |
| `db_query_ms` (`sql.conn.query` / `sql.conn.exec`) | Application SQL driver query/exec start to result return | Emitted as child OTel spans (`db.system=postgresql`, `db.operation=SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE`); raw SQL text is scrubbed at both SDK and Collector layers. |

- **Unobserved Client RTT (`unknown` / `not_observed`)**: When client-side TCP RTT is not directly accessible from a reverse proxy or container namespace, `transport` or RTT fields remain `unknown` / omitted rather than fabricating `0 ms`.
- **Cross-Chain Drill-Down**: Use the top-right **[Traffic Statistics & Billing Chain](/grafana/d/dual-link-traffic-accounting/traffic-statistics-and-billing-chain)** link to jump directly to the Exporter → Vector → Billing → PostgreSQL → Accounts pipeline with the same time window and filter variables.
